name: Cursor Agent Guardrails
description: Defines hard boundaries to prevent Cursor agents from generating out-of-scope features or architecture changes.

rules.rule: Do not add any subscription tier beyond Free and Pro.
Do not implement tagging or tag filters.
Do not make document requests visible to other users.
Do not add public-facing user profiles or profile editing features.
Do not add non-requested integrations (e.g. Google Drive, Calendars).
Do not add analytics dashboards beyond download count and subscription status.
Do not use libraries that increase cost or complexity unless explicitly approved.
Do not expose any admin-only logic to non-admin users.
